description: Return ClassCAD MCP session status: the drawing's id, the link of the app docked into this session (app) or of the read-only 3D view (viewer), the link the session is shared with others under (shared; null while it is not), who else is in the session (peers), sign-in (auth), transport (ws = ClassCAD worker, wasm = the MCP's own local engine), engine policy, whether a local WASM engine is available, WS URL, current session id, the invite this session joined with (shareToken), connection state, package version. DAEMON: every connection of a host to this MCP is a session in ONE shared daemon process per machine (127.0.0.1:9097), with the drawings its conversations opened; it exits a minute after its last session. Rebuilt MCP/renderer code only runs in a new daemon — an idle one is replaced automatically. Shell commands: `node "/scratch/pkg/node_modules/@classcad/mcp/dist/server.js" status` (pid, build, sessions); `node "/scratch/pkg/node_modules/@classcad/mcp/dist/server.js" stop` (stops it only when no session is active); `node "/scratch/pkg/node_modules/@classcad/mcp/dist/server.js" stop --force` (terminates it NOW — every connected host, this one included, loses its drawings: ask the user first. Tabs reconnect to a fresh daemon on their next tool call; tabs started before this MCP version need a host restart). Never kill daemon processes by hand.

drawing.description: The drawing this call works on. "new" opens a new, empty drawing, and the answer names its id; from then on pass that id (e.g. "d-k3v9q2xa") in every call of this conversation about that model. A drawing belongs to the conversation that opened it: no other conversation can see or change it.
